quality_gate.numeric_promotion_policy: Facility-level annual numeric emissions are promoted only after direct parse/readback from an authoritative official dataset. Exact official report links plus secondary mirror values are not sufficient for measured_emission_rows.
quality_gate.official_union_registry_status: European Commission Union Registry explicitly publishes installation-level verified-emissions reports; exact 2018, 2019 and 2020 XLSX URLs were resolved in this pass.
quality_gate.official_binary_read_status: 2018 XLSX returned official spreadsheet content type but the current text client could not parse it; 2019 and 2020 official downloads returned bounded HTTP 429 in this pass. No numeric official row was claimed.
quality_gate.eea_current_status: EEA July 2026 EU ETS dataset is current, covers 2005-2025 and mainly derives from the European Commission Union Registry; facility-level direct download content was not parsed in this client.
quality_gate.candidate_source_policy: Secondary EUTL-linked mirror values may remain confidence-99 candidates only when current official Environment Agency identity and historical official ETS identifier align without unresolved facility ambiguity.
